user.description: Choose the device and binary sensor for tracking. Distance and time utility meter periods are selected independently.

data.Choose the binary sensor that needs to b: Choose the binary sensor that needs to be on to track
data.Create daily distance utility meter (res: Create daily distance utility meter (resets every day)
data.Create weekly distance utility meter (re: Create weekly distance utility meter (resets every week)
data.Create monthly distance utility meter (r: Create monthly distance utility meter (resets every month)
data.Create daily time utility meter (resets: Create daily time utility meter (resets every day)
data.Create weekly time utility meter (resets: Create weekly time utility meter (resets every week)
data.Create monthly time utility meter (reset: Create monthly time utility meter (resets every month)

data_description.Choose the device to track: Select the device tracker whose GPS location should be used to calculate distance.
data_description.Choose the binary sensor that needs to b: Distance is recorded only while this binary sensor is on.
data_description.Distance unit: Choose whether distance is measured in kilometers or miles. Distance helpers use the same unit.
data_description.Create daily distance utility meter (res: Creates a meter that totals the distance traveled and resets daily.
data_description.Create weekly distance utility meter (re: Creates a meter that totals the distance traveled and resets weekly.
data_description.Create monthly distance utility meter (r: Creates a meter that totals the distance traveled and resets monthly.
data_description.Create daily time utility meter (resets: Check this to create a separate helper that totals time in hours spent with the binary sensor on, resetting daily.
data_description.Create weekly time utility meter (resets: Check this to create a separate helper that totals time in hours spent with the binary sensor on, resetting weekly.
data_description.Create monthly time utility meter (reset: Check this to create a separate helper that totals time in hours spent with the binary sensor on, resetting monthly.
data_description.Name for the distance sensor: Enter the name you want Home Assistant to show for the distance sensor.

init.title: Manage utility meters
init.description: Tick the boxes next to utility meters to delete them; unchecked meters are kept. Options to create distance or time utility meters are shown only when that meter is missing. {meter_count} linked utility meter(s) found.

data.Select utility meters to delete (uncheck: Select utility meters to delete (unchecked meters are kept)
data.Create daily distance utility meter if m: Create daily distance utility meter if missing
data.Create weekly distance utility meter if: Create weekly distance utility meter if missing
data.Create monthly distance utility meter if: Create monthly distance utility meter if missing
data.Create daily time utility meter if missi: Create daily time utility meter if missing
data.Create weekly time utility meter if miss: Create weekly time utility meter if missing
data.Create monthly time utility meter if mis: Create monthly time utility meter if missing

data_description.Select utility meters to delete (uncheck: Select the meters to delete. Any meter you leave unselected will be kept.
data_description.Create daily distance utility meter if m: Create a daily helper for the distance sensor if one does not already exist.
data_description.Create weekly distance utility meter if: Create a weekly helper for the distance sensor if one does not already exist.
data_description.Create monthly distance utility meter if: Create a monthly helper for the distance sensor if one does not already exist.
data_description.Create daily time utility meter if missi: Create a daily helper in hours for the time-spent sensor if one does not already exist.
data_description.Create weekly time utility meter if miss: Create a weekly helper in hours for the time-spent sensor if one does not already exist.
data_description.Create monthly time utility meter if mis: Create a monthly helper in hours for the time-spent sensor if one does not already exist.
